============================================================ Dead Of Alive: Xtream Venus Vaction Pack ============================================================ This pack brings Tamaki from DOAXVV into Left 4 Dead 2! It replaces all survivors across both groups (L4D1 & L4D2). [FEATURES] - Full survivor replacements (Bill, Francis, Louis, Zoey, Nick, Coach, Ellis, Rochelle) - Clean models, custom textures, and materials - Standalone single-survivor VPKs mixed with All-in-One variants - Contains mature model adjustments - Four different skin models This package includes 10 standalone VPK files. Pick and choose exactly what you want to install in your addons folder: • survivor_bill.vpk -> Replaces Bill only • survivor_francis.vpk -> Replaces Francis only • survivor_louis.vpk -> Replaces Louis only • survivor_zoey.vpk -> Replaces Zoey only • survivor_coach.vpk -> Replaces Coach only • survivor_ellis.vpk -> Replaces Ellis only • survivor_nick.vpk -> Replaces Nick only • survivor_rochelle.vpk -> Replaces Rochelle only • all-in-one.vpk -> Replaces EVERY survivor at once • all-in-one v2.vpk -> Replaces EVERY survivor, but includes Zoey's voice only

item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
**FORWARD VELOCITY: HALLOWEEN EDITION** A fast-paced Left 4 Dead 2 challenge featuring three selectable maps: - **Map 1 – No Supplies:** Survive using only your skills and available resources. - **Map 2 – Supplies:** The same challenge, with additional supplies and ammunition. - **Map 3 – Mega Pumpkin:** A giant Halloween pumpkin hunts down the survivors. Keep moving! Encounter three special parasitic eyes with unique abilities: the Stalking Eye, the Hypnotic Eye and the Cloning Eye. Inspired by Sonic Heroes, with colorful environments, Frutiger Aero elements and a Halloween atmosphere. Designed around speed, zombie evasion and challenging gameplay. **Keep moving!**
